title: Streaming rerank evaluation orchestration with A/B signal hooks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a streaming evaluation orchestration service for reranking that continuously computes NDCG and MRR on incoming production traffic and customer prompt sets, and exposes A/B signal hooks for downstream experiments. The goal is to provide near-real-time quality metrics tied to model variants and routing policies without adding significant tail latency to serving. This work covers ingestion, sampling, synchronous and asynchronous scoring paths, ground-truth binding using customer promptsets, and integration with Dashboard and AB analysis pipelines.
acceptance_criteria: Streaming pipeline ingests sample trace events (request, chosen candidates, ground truth labels) at 10k req/s sustained.
Per-variant NDCG@10 and MRR reported on 1m and 1h rolling windows with max 2% measurement error vs offline baseline.
A/B experiment signals (variant id, treatment assignment, outcome metrics) exported to analytics and available via API within 5 minutes of events.
End-to-end latency impact on the serving path is <= 5ms p95 for sampled requests; default non-sampled requests unchanged.
Customer promptset ingestion flow supports CSV/JSON and maps to canonical ground-truth schema; sample customer integrated for validation.
Dashboard panels and alerting thresholds created in Console for NDGC/MRR regressions and sudden distribution shifts.
implementation_notes: Use a lightweight sampling layer in the serving runtime to emit events to a Kafka topic; default sampling 1% with per-customer overrides.
Streaming processor will be built on Flink/Beam (prototype with Beam Python) to compute windowed NDCG and MRR and materialize per-variant timeseries.
For latency-sensitive paths implement a synchronous 'shadow' eval that hashes candidate scores and emits only metadata to reduce payload size.
Ground truth joins for customer promptsets will use a TTL-indexed store (Bigtable/Redis) to bind label for late-arriving annotations.
Expose A/B hooks through existing rollout config: add treatment tag and experiment id to emitted events; support deterministic bucketing by user id.
Metrics exported via Prometheus and a labeled timeseries namespace 'rerank.eval' with variant and customer tags.
Use the existing ndcg/mrr library in repo but add streaming-optimized incremental update routines to avoid recomputing full lists on each window.
Plan for backpressure: if the processor lags fall back to aggregated daily batch windows and emit sampling health metric.

test_plan: Unit tests for ndcg/mrr incremental logic with corner cases (duplicate candidates, empty labels, partial lists)
Integration test: end-to-end request -> sampler -> processor -> timeseries store using local Beam runner
Load test: 15k events/s for 2h sustained with sampling 1% and observe processor lag < 5m
AB analysis test: inject synthetic treatment with known uplift and verify exported metrics reflect expected delta with p-value calc
Privacy test: ensure PII redaction and KMS encryption for stored ground-truth rows
rollout_plan: Canary: enable sampling for 0.1% of traffic on internal tenants for 48 hours
Stage: increase sampling to 0.5% for select customers and validate dashboards and latency guarantees
Gradual: ramp to 1% global sampling with autoscaling Beam clusters and validate AB export latency
Full: enable per-customer overrides and onboard first external customer promptset
notes_on_cost_latency_tradeoffs: Higher sampling reduces estimator variance but increases telemetry cost; default 1% balances cost and detection sensitivity for medium customers.
Synchronous shadow evals add ~3-5ms p95 on sampled requests; we restrict to sampled traffic and compress payload to minimize impact.
Streaming computation uses keyed windows to reduce cross-worker shuffles at the cost of skew hotspots which require mitigation via variant-id hashing.
telemetry_schema: rerank.eval.ndcg@window - float - NDCG value for configured window (tags: variant, customer, window)
rerank.eval.mrr@window - float - MRR value for configured window (tags: variant, customer, window)
rerank.eval.sampled_requests - counter - number of sampled requests emitted (tags: customer, variant)
rerank.eval.processing_lag_seconds - gauge - processing lag in seconds (tags: worker, partition)
rerank.eval.ab_export_latency_seconds - histogram - time to export AB signals to analytics
